signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to join your sessions, take exams and download certificates.
signIn.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.nextNote: Sign in or create an account to continue with your enrolment.

demo.title: Explore the demo
demo.lead: Sign in as a fictional sample account to look around. Available on this demonstration site only.
demo.learnerHint: Upcoming class, exam and a sample certificate

register.title: Create your account
register.lead: It takes about a minute. You will use this account to join sessions, take exams and keep your certificates.
register.name: Full name (English)
register.nameHint: Exactly as it should appear on your certificates.
register.nameArHint: Shown on the Arabic side of your certificates.
register.phoneHint: Saudi mobile, for example 05X XXX XXXX.
register.consent: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
register.noId: We do not ask for your national ID or Iqama number.

company.title: Create a company account
company.lead: Set up your organisation, then buy seats and invite your employees.
company.contactHint: You will be the manager of this company account.
company.crHint: 10 digits. You can add this later.
company.vatHint: 15 digits. Only needed if you want it on your invoices.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.demoNote: Demo: emails are not sent. An administrator can read the message in Admin → Email outbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.missing: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

invite.title: You have been invited
invite.body: {company} has invited you to join its training account on Aman Academy.
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invite.invalidBody: It may have expired or been withdrawn. Ask your company to send a new invitation.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in with a different email address. Sign out, then open the invitation link again.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.profileLead: Your name is printed on certificates, so please keep it accurate.
settings.emailNote: Contact support to change your email address.
settings.demoNote: This is a demo account shared by everyone trying the site. Please do not store real personal details in it.
